name: Traveler (Pyro)
notes: Both sources: 4pc Scroll of the Hero of Cinder City (KQM's general best-in-slot for its 40% shared bonus), an ER-first Sands (KQM: ER, ATK% or EM; Game8: ATK% or ER), a Pyro DMG or ATK% Goblet and a CRIT Circlet (KQM also allows EM). KQM adds Tenacity of the Millelith, Noblesse Oblige, Instructor and Deepwood Memories for teams where a teammate already holds the Scroll. Weapons differ in the lead: KQM puts Favonius Sword first for the off-field role, Game8 Mistsplitter Reforged for a Pyro sub-DPS; both are kept. Talent order differs: KQM is character level first, then Burst >= Skill >>> Normal Attack, Game8 is Skill > Burst > Normal Attack; the card uses KQM's, because the Burst's Plains Scorcher (427.2% to 769.0%, elemental curve) is the damage line. ER is KQM's off-field support table, 245-300 without a Favonius sword and 195-235 with one; 260 is used for the Scroll team with a Natlan unit (255-280). The on-field DPS need is far lower (115-175). No ATK or CRIT goal is given.
